description.en: My work in Sales X-Ray shows everything you did: calls, how they went, notes and stage moves, for today, yesterday or this week. Add a note to any lead in seconds.
description.hi: Sales X-Ray mein My work aapka sab kaam dikhata hai: calls, kaise rahe, notes aur stage moves, aaj, kal ya is hafte ke. Kisi bhi lead pe seconds mein note likhiye.
description.mr: Sales X-Ray madhla My work tumcha sagla kaam dakhavto: calls, kase jhale, notes aani stage moves, aaj, kaal kinva ya athavdyache. Kuthlyahi lead var kahi seconds madhye note liha.

names.Can I show you in 10 minutes how: Can I quickly show you how

title.en: All leads: filter, sort and saved views
title.hi: All leads: filter, sort aur saved views
title.mr: All leads: filter, sort aani saved views

say.en: In this video: My work, your day at a glance, and quick notes.
say.hi: इस video में: My work, आपका पूरा दिन एक नज़र में, और quick notes.
say.mr: या video मध्ये: My work, तुमचा पूर्ण दिवस एका नजरेत, आणि quick notes.

latn.hi: Is video mein: My work, aapka poora din ek nazar mein, aur quick notes.
latn.mr: Ya video madhye: My work, tumcha poorna divas eka najret, aani quick notes.

say.en: Next: All leads, with filter, sort and saved views.
say.hi: अगले video में: All leads, filter, sort और saved views के साथ.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: All leads, filter, sort आणि saved views सकट.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: All leads, filter, sort aur saved views ke saath.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: All leads, filter, sort aani saved views sakat.

say.en: What did you get done today? It's all on one screen.
say.hi: आज क्या क्या किया? सब एक ही screen पे.
say.mr: आज काय काय केलं? सगळं एकाच screen वर.

latn.hi: Aaj kya kya kiya? Sab ek hi screen pe.
latn.mr: Aaj kay kay kela? Sagla ekach screen var.

say.en: In Leads, tap My work. It shows everything you did, newest first.
say.hi: Leads में My work दबाइए. आपने जो भी किया, सब दिखता है, सबसे नया सबसे ऊपर.
say.mr: Leads मध्ये My work दाबा. तुम्ही जे काही केलं, सगळं दिसतं, सगळ्यात नवीन सगळ्यात वर.

latn.hi: Leads mein My work dabaiye. Aapne jo bhi kiya, sab dikhta hai, sabse naya sabse upar.
latn.mr: Leads madhye My work daba. Tumhi je kahi kela, sagla dista, saglyat navin saglyat var.

say.en: The top line adds up your day: calls, notes and stage moves.
say.hi: सबसे ऊपर की line पूरा दिन जोड़ देती है: calls, notes और stage moves.
say.mr: सगळ्यात वरची line पूर्ण दिवसाची बेरीज देते: calls, notes आणि stage moves.

latn.hi: Sabse upar ki line poora din jod deti hai: calls, notes aur stage moves.
latn.mr: Saglyat varchi line poorna divasachi berij dete: calls, notes aani stage moves.

say.en: Calls, notes, stage moves: added up.
say.hi: Calls, notes, stage moves: सब जुड़ा हुआ.
say.mr: Calls, notes, stage moves: सगळं एकत्र.

latn.hi: Calls, notes, stage moves: sab juda hua.
latn.mr: Calls, notes, stage moves: sagla ektra.

say.en: Each line says what happened: who you talked to and how it went, calls from your phone, and leads you moved.
say.hi: हर line बताती है क्या हुआ: किससे बात हुई और कैसी रही, phone से किए calls, और कौन से leads आगे बढ़ाए.
say.mr: प्रत्येक line सांगते काय झालं: कोणाशी बोललात आणि कसं झालं, phone वरून केलेले calls, आणि कुठले leads पुढे नेले.

latn.hi: Har line batati hai kya hua: kisse baat hui aur kaisi rahi, phone se kiye calls, aur kaun se leads aage badhaye.
latn.mr: Pratyek line sangte kay jhala: konashi bollat aani kasa jhala, phone varun kelele calls, aani kuthle leads pudhe nele.

say.en: Your notes are here too, so you pick up exactly where you left off.
say.hi: आपके notes भी यहीं हैं, तो जहाँ छोड़ा था वहीं से शुरू कीजिए.
say.mr: तुमच्या notes पण इथेच आहेत, म्हणजे जिथे थांबलात तिथूनच सुरू करा.

latn.hi: Aapke notes bhi yahin hain, toh jahan chhoda tha wahin se shuru kijiye.
latn.mr: Tumchya notes pan ithech aahet, mhanje jithe thamblat tithunach suru kara.

say.en: Look back at yesterday, or your whole week.
say.hi: कल का देखिए, या पूरे हफ़्ते का.

latn.hi: Kal ka dekhiye, ya poore hafte ka.

say.en: On any lead, tap Add a note to jot something down in seconds, like: call after seven.
say.hi: किसी भी lead पे Add a note दबाइए, और seconds में कुछ भी लिख लीजिए, जैसे: सात बजे के बाद call.
say.mr: कुठल्याही lead वर Add a note दाबा, आणि काही seconds मध्ये काहीही लिहून ठेवा, जसं: सात नंतर call.

latn.hi: Kisi bhi lead pe Add a note dabaiye, aur seconds mein kuch bhi likh lijiye, jaise: saat baje ke baad call.
latn.mr: Kuthlyahi lead var Add a note daba, aani kahi seconds madhye kaahihi lihun theva, jasa: saat nantar call.
